description: This file defines synchronization utilities for IARM bus event handling, including templates for managing event handlers per class, registration, and removal functions with thread safety mechanisms.

classes.name: Utils::Synchro::IarmHandlers
classes.description: Template struct managing a static map of IARM event handlers per class type.

methods.name: _generic_iarm_handler
methods.description: Template function acting as a generic handler for IARM events, dispatching to registered handlers with thread safety.

methods.name: RegisterLockedIarmEventHandler
methods.description: Template function to register an event handler with thread safety, associating it with a specific owner and event ID.

methods.name: RemoveLockedEventHandler
methods.description: Template function to remove an event handler with thread safety, logging if the handler differs from the registered one.
